task: T2: add mutant parsing to scripts/gate-selftest.sh. Each file directly under the task directory's `mutants/` is a mutant: a complete replacement artifact whose leading comment lines carry three fields — `MUTANT:` naming the assertion id it must break, `TARGET:` giving the repository-relative path it replaces, and `WHY:` explaining the defect it introduces. Read all three from each file. A mutant missing `MUTANT:` or missing `TARGET:` is an ERROR that fails the run, naming the file — never a skip: a silently skipped mutant is an assertion nobody is checking, which is the precise state this tool exists to detect, so the tool must not be able to create it. `WHY:` is required to be present but its content is free text; carry it, because it is what a failure message needs in order to explain itself. Accept the fields in any order and allow other comment lines around them. Print nothing per mutant in this task and run nothing: T3 installs and runs them, T4 decides verdicts. Change no behaviour added in T1.
